title: Ask Request v1.0 — evidence-first Plan-Gate ingestion
description: Primary context is layer5.evidence_bundle.v1; no repo_root / ContextEngine on this path.

evidence_bundle.description: Full layer5.evidence_bundle.v1 object; validated separately with strict L5 schema.

expected_workspace_identity_hash.description: If set, must equal evidence_bundle.workspace_identity_hash or request is rejected.

revision.description: Optional display revision for context_bundle (e.g. git SHA); not used for filesystem access.

client_context.description: Optional IDE context. Supports selection text and optional dirty buffer overlay payload for L5.7.

dirty_buffers.description: Unsaved editor buffers eligible for deterministic overlay during Ask/Debug context assembly.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path for the unsaved buffer.

content.description: Full current unsaved content for the file path.

trace_id.description: End-to-end correlation ID (same across v1 and fallback v0 for one logical Ask).

response_extensions.description: Optional additive response extensions requested by client. Unsupported values are rejected for deterministic negotiation.
